name: Man'in Chijo Densha 3 ~Chijo Forever~
source:
Even so, I just can't give up!

In the previous story, my sister Yumi and the cute little brother-type Masaki got together. Finally, the fruit of their love grew inside Yumi's belly.

But just as they reached the peak of happiness, another obstacle appeared, threatening to tear them apart.

“...I still can't forget him.”

Ena, who once stepped aside for her best friend Yumi. But every day since then has been empty like a gaping hole in her heart. 

Every time she sees Yumi's belly grow, she wonders if that could have been her. Thinking that makes her cherish Masaki even more...        

Then, a voice appears before Ena, rubbing salt in the wound.

“You can't forget him, can you? Then just take him away.”

Hearing that whisper, Ena...
